scope.type: bounded independent research-record audit; not full factual approval
not_performed: Full live verification of every cited URL or every recognition claim
Full semantic synonym search or independent historical tombstone audit
Board authoring, native-topology tests or playtests

checks.novelty_interpretation: Twelve proposed shared senses classified for research; neither twelve adopted concepts nor twelve verified ready candidates.
checks.source_access_limit: Only the three sampled URLs below were independently reopened in this audit. Search-result access is explicitly distinguished in the pool and is not upgraded to full-page verification.
checks.form_identity_method: Compared all 34 checked forms and every proposed label against the loaded KG label/alias index using wordgames.service.normalize.
checks.lifecycle_assessment: The researched state retains evidence and explicit uncertainty; held records name unresolved sense/input dependencies. No record uses an installation approval state. Researched Ață still records its held needle dependency and does not claim the pairing is ready.

sampled_sources.original_attribution: DEX 2009 entry as reproduced and credited by dexonline
sampled_sources.actual_evidence: The entry distinguishes glass material, window panes and liquid containers, and includes opaque glass.
sampled_sources.result: supports sampled claims and the material/container hold
sampled_sources.limit: The dictionary does not establish which sense a player intends or settle the alias policy.

sampled_sources.access: PDF extracted text read; screenshot attempts returned cache miss
sampled_sources.original_attribution: Ministerul Educatiei si Cercetarii, national technology olympiad, grade VII, 24 April 2025
sampled_sources.location: Page 1 header; page 2 Subject II.A.1; page 3 Subject III opening text
sampled_sources.actual_evidence: The competition paper names sewing thread, buttons and zippers, then asks about making a wooden small table.
sampled_sources.result: supports lexical school exposure and the wooden-furniture example
sampled_sources.limit: Selective olympiad participation is not universal school exposure, population recognition, proof of a kitchen-specific table, or a completed section-F gate. No table-cell interpretation or visual inspection is claimed.

sampled_sources.original_attribution: HORNBACH Romanian product description for a Hettich door hinge
sampled_sources.location: Product description and wood-door compatibility answer
sampled_sources.actual_evidence: The retailer describes fastening the hinge to the door edge and frame, controlled opening/closing, and use with wooden doors.
sampled_sources.result: supports a concrete hinge/frame application and the existence of wooden doors
sampled_sources.limit: Commercial product evidence does not prove broad recognition, exclusivity to doors, or properties of every door.

findings.finding: The phrase 2025 grade-VII national exam can be read as the general national assessment. The cited source is the national technology olympiad, a selective competition.
findings.recommended_action: Use 2025 grade-VII national technology olympiad paper. Preserve the existing limitation that this does not show population-wide recognition.
findings.required_before_readiness: Wording correction satisfied. Recognition and all other adoption checks remain open.
findings.resolution: Verified the corrected signal now names the 2025 grade-VII national technology olympiad. All five affected source notes explicitly limit this to selective competition exposure; the two school_use claims now name the olympiad.

findings.finding: Qualified labels avoid exact index collisions but do not solve likely player inputs. Bare masa belongs to the meal node and ac normalizes to the existing AC alias; intrare and sticla still have unresolved sense overlap.
findings.recommended_action: Keep these held until separately reviewed disambiguation and input behavior preserve existing identities. Do not count morphology or a qualified spelling as an adopted new concept.

findings.finding: Door parts do not apply to every door; curtains also occur at doors; hinges occur outside household doors. Needle/thread/button/zipper/garment sketches can generate competing valid pairings. The school source proves word exposure rather than unique pairings.
findings.recommended_action: Require exact scoped relations and complete-board counterexample checks during refinement. Preserve Fermoar-Ghiozdan as unverified and retain the held needle dependency.

findings.finding: No material contradiction was found in the three sampled source classes. That result cannot certify all 31 supported annotations, all historical-rejection checks, all recognition assessments, or the semantic novelty of twelve senses.
findings.recommended_action: Reopen material primary sources, redo sense/alias and novelty checks, and use independent factual and quality reviewers for any exact selected revision.

conclusion: Research-only pool is consistent with its stated 8 researched/4 held counts and zero adoption. The minor source-label finding was corrected and independently rechecked; no sampled factual contradiction requires deleting research.

adoption_boundary.required: Selection must freeze a reviewed record revision and exact dependencies, then create a separate candidate proposal for the shared-graph transaction and affected game-specific review rails. Pool hashes, research annotations and this sampled audit are not importer approval artifacts.
adoption_boundary.unchanged_inputs: The auditor did not modify the pool, KG, runtime, aliases, fixtures or any game record.

finding_resolution_history.change: Author narrowed school-source notes, recognition labels and two education-exposure predicates to the selective national technology olympiad. The auditor re-read all five school-source records and revalidated source references and lifecycle counts.
finding_resolution_history.record_revision_note: This remains the initial unselected pool draft at revision 1; the before/after exact pool hashes here preserve the review correction. Any later selected-record change must follow the pool contract revision and snapshot rules.
